description: Unit tests for NSSCertDatabaseChromeOS, testing certificate import, listing, trust settings, and module listing in a ChromeOS environment.

classes.name: NSSCertDatabaseChromeOSTest
classes.description: Test fixture for NSSCertDatabaseChromeOS, setting up user slots and testing certificate database operations.

methods.name: ListModules
methods.description: Tests that each user's module list includes their own slot and excludes others.

methods.name: ImportCACerts
methods.description: Tests importing CA certificates and verifying they appear in the correct user's certificate list.

methods.name: ImportServerCert
methods.description: Tests importing server certificates and verifying correct association with users.

methods.name: NoCrashIfShutdownBeforeDoneOnWorkerPool
methods.description: Ensures no crash occurs if database is deleted during asynchronous listing.

methods.name: ListCertsReadsSystemSlot
methods.description: Verifies listing certificates reads from the system slot.

methods.name: ListCertsDoesNotCrossReadSystemSlot
methods.description: Verifies listing certificates does not read from the system slot when using a different slot.

methods.name: SetCertTrustCertIsAlreadyOnPublicSlot
methods.description: Tests setting trust on a certificate already on the public slot.

methods.name: SetCertTrustCertIsOnlyOnOtherSlot
methods.description: Tests trust setting when the certificate is only on a different slot, ensuring it moves to the public slot.

methods.name: SetCertTrustPublicSlotIsSystemSlot
methods.description: Tests behavior when the public slot is the system slot, expecting trust modification to fail.
